notes: All seven web searches ran in this second attempt (the six required plus one on the Ban Artificial Superintelligence Act). None found any statement by Fallon on superintelligence, extinction or existential risk, a pause or slowdown, an agreement with China, or AI safety; results for those queries did not mention him. Ban Artificial Superintelligence Act (H.R. 10538, introduced 24 Sep 2026): the fastdemocracy.com bill page lists 12 cosponsors (all Democrats) and Fallon is not among them; Congress.gov itself was not checked. A September 2025 House Oversight subcommittee hearing on AI ('Shaping Tomorrow: The Future of Artificial Intelligence', govinfo CHRG-119hhrg61734) came up; Fallon was not present and said nothing in it. From the earlier attempt (still valid): fallon.house.gov press release list pages 1 to 4 (January 2025 to October 2026) were checked; the only AI releases were the two 2025 defense items in 'record'. The FAST Act quote was shown whole, but apostrophe style (straight or curly) was not verified. Left out: 15 May 2025 Protecting AI and Cloud Competition in Defense Act release quotes (about AI and cloud data needing to be secure against cyber threats for national security), because exact continuous wording could not be confirmed; they would be D under ruling 4. He also wrote a National Interest op-ed titled 'Free Market Involvement in AI Is the Key to the US Military's Future Success' (linked from the FAST Act release; not opened, date not checked). No House letter on AI risk led or signed by him was found.
